from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Derivatives measure the rate of change precisely.",
            "The speedometer shows instantaneous speed changes.",
            "The derivative represents the curve's slope."
        ]

        # --- Animation components ---
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 4, 1], y_range=[0, 4, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False}, x_length=4, y_length=4)
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.25 * x**3, color="#FF4500")
        
        # Place axes area
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B3", "E6", scale_factor=0.7)
        curve.match_y(axes)
        curve.match_x(axes)
        
        # Speedometer asset
        speedometer = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speedometer.svg")
        self.place_at_grid(speedometer, "B5", scale_factor=0.3)
        
        point = ValueTracker(1.0)
        
        # Tangent line (simplified to avoid complex redraw)
        tangent = Line(start=LEFT*0.5, end=RIGHT*0.5, color="#FFFF00")
        
        # Setup slope label
        slope_text = Text("Slope: ", font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        slope_val = DecimalNumber(0.75, num_decimal_places=2, font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        slope_group = VGroup(slope_text, slope_val).arrange(RIGHT)
        self.place_at_grid(slope_group, "E2", scale_factor=0.8)

        # Updaters for tangent and value

            x = point.get_value()

        def update_val(v):

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FFFF00"))
        self.play(FadeIn(speedometer))
        self.add(tangent)
        self.play(point.animate.set_value(3.0), run_time=3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_group))
        self.play(point.animate.set_value(1.0), run_time=2)
        
        # Remove updaters before end
        self.wait(1)
        tangent.remove_updater(update_tangent)
        slope_val.remove_updater(update_val)
